text: Assumption: The bus-off recovery restarts the controller via Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_CS_STARTED) — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The bus-off recovery restarts the controller via Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_CS_STARTED) — is this correct?
norm: the bus off recovery restarts the controller via can_setcontrollermode can_cs_started
assumption: The bus-off recovery restarts the controller via Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_CS_STARTED).
rationale: According to SWS CANInterface page 138, recovery is the responsibility of CanSM; according to SWS CANDriver page 59, every transition to STARTED reinitializes; the concrete restart path is not substantiated (also marked as an interpretation in diagram diag-busoff).

original.text: Annahme: Die Bus-off-Recovery startet den Controller wieder über Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_CS_STARTED) — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die Bus-off-Recovery startet den Controller wieder über Can_SetControllerMode(CAN_CS_STARTED)
original.rationale: Laut SWS CANInterface S. 138 liegt die Recovery beim CanSM, laut SWS CANDriver S. 59 initialisiert jeder Übergang nach STARTED neu; der konkrete Neustartpfad ist nicht belegt (auch im Diagramm diag-busoff als Interpretation markiert).
